title: Whether his wife worked at Tom Anderson's
summary: He is asked if his wife once worked at Tom Anderson's and jokes about having had many wives.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: Did you tell me one time a few years ago your wife worked at Tom Anderson's too? Did she... I told you what? Did your wife work at Tom Anderson's once? My wife?

Yeah, I was... Maybe it was my wife before my dad. You had so many of them, huh? Yeah, oh man. I had so many of them in my life. If I don't collect them all this world, I would have worked with something. I don't know.
